# UByte 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

```blitzbasic
UByte value#  ; returns Int
```

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a UByte, an 8-bit integer from 0 to 255. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A whole number that is too large or below 0 keeps its lowest 8 bits (`UByte(-1)` is 255), a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) and stops at 0 or 255 if it is outside. Use [SatUByte](SatUByte) to stop whole numbers at 0 and 255 as well.

```blitzbasic
Print UByte(200)
Print UByte(-1)
Print UByte(256)
Print UByte(300.0)
```

```text
200
255
0
255
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The UByte.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
